requirements.text: 5+ years of experience in software engineering, automation engineering, SDET, backend validation, or capital markets technology.
Hands-on experience with swaps, derivatives, fixed income, or broader capital markets systems.
Strong understanding of trade lifecycle concepts across trading, post-trade, risk, settlement, reporting, or downstream processing.
Python coding, scripting, automation, or debugging experience.
Experience with backend validation, API testing, SQL, data validation, or automation framework development.
Familiarity with trading systems, risk systems, post-trade platforms, OMS/EMS workflows, market data, FIX, messaging, or internal financial systems.
Experience with capital markets platforms such as Murex, Sophis, Summit, Calypso, Aladdin, Charles River, DTCC, Omgeo, Bloomberg, Tradeweb, DealerWeb, ION, Broadridge, or similar systems is a plus.
Strong SQL skills for validating trade data, reconciliation results, reporting outputs, and source-to-target data flows.
Ability to work in Agile/Scrum environments with developers, business stakeholders, and cross-functional technology teams.
Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical and business issues clearly.
